title: 1:1 prep - Ethan Rivera
content:
1:1 with Ethan Rivera - prep notes (weekly)
Date: 2026-03-03 11:00am
Location: Zoom / w/agenda in thread

Objectives for this 1:1:
- Quick sync on current priorities (projects + oncall)
- Surface blockers and decide next steps
- Career/feedback: check progress on IC3 -> IC4 goals, discuss growth plan
- Review last meeting action items and close/follow up
- Align on what I can remove/solve as a manager vs what to empower him to own

Background/context to remind myself:
- Ethan is the primary owner for KV-cache perf work (ENG-542). We saw a perf regression in canary two weeks ago; PR #278 fixes the worst of it but still seeing tail latency on 8k sequences. He owns perf testing harness and the follow-up instrumentation.
- He rotated off oncall last week but is on the pager for storage-related alerts. He mentioned burnout risk last month; keep check-ins light and focus on prioritization.
- Career: Ethan volunteered to lead a small spike on quantization-friendly kernel selection; wants more leadership experience. He sent a draft promotion packet to me (looking at technical impact, cross-team work).

Agenda (30 mins)
1) Status quick rundowns (8m)
   - KV-cache perf (what's left after PR #278?)
   - E2E regression test results: perf harness numbers? Any non-deterministic failures?
2) Blockers & resourcing (8m)
   - Any infra blockers or needed infra tickets? (SRE for deeper kernel profiling?)
   - Do we need to swap priorities or pull in an additional engineer for tests?
3) Career & growth (7m)
   - Review promotion packet: gaps, evidence to collect, next deliverables
   - Growth opportunities: owning a cross-team initiative for kernel pairing with infra team
4) Action items & follow-ups (5m)

Notes / talking points to use during meeting:
- Start by asking: "What single thing would make your next two weeks feel unblocked?"
- Confirm scope of PR #278: is it sufficient as a rollback candidate if canary shows regression?
- Probe test stability: "How frequently does the harness hit the regression? Are we confident in the numbers?"
- Ask about pairing preferences: would he prefer short pairing sessions or a 2-day focused block to onboard a helper?
- Career: ask him to identify 2 cross-team outcomes that demonstrate leadership (not just technical).
- Burnout check: how is focus/time allocation, sleep, sustainable pace? Offer to re-prioritize non-critical tasks.

Follow-ups from last 1:1 (status)
- I was going to review his draft promotion packet and leave comments (status: left initial comments 2026-02-25; he was going to update examples with impact metrics).
- He was going to schedule pair time with Priya for kernel profiling (status: Priya confirmed 2/28 pairing; Ethan to share notes).
- He was going to add histogram logging for tail latency to the perf harness (status: in progress; PR opened, waiting for CI).

New action items (who/when)
- Ethan: finalize perf harness histogram logging and add runbook note for how to reproduce tail latency (due: 2026-03-07).
- Maya (me): follow up with SRE (Taylor Nguyen) to request access to deeper kernel traces and ask for an exploratory pairing session (due: 2026-03-05).
- Ethan + Priya: 2-hour pairing to instrument kernel-level metrics and validate PR #278 on a larger sample (schedule: next week; target completion: 2026-03-10).
- Maya: summarize promotion packet feedback and send clear list of missing artifacts (due: 2026-03-04).

Potential escalations / decisions needed:
- If harness still shows non-deterministic tail after pairing, consider rolling back the canary and schedule a rollback plan. Need to confirm rollback criteria and owner.
- If Ethan is overloaded, propose temporarily reassigning the Evals integration task to Jordan for two sprints.

Notes to self (private manager commentary)
- Keep tone supportive: acknowledge the stress of production bug + oncall.
- Push for smaller measurable wins to build momentum (e.g., "add histogram & reproduce flow" rather than end-to-end fix in one go).
- Look for opportunities to give Ethan visible credit in the weekly eng sync if the kernel profiling yields clear findings.
- Watch for signs of sustained overtime; offer to block 50% of his calendar for focused work if helpful.

Misc links to bring up in meeting:
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/278
- Jira: ENG-542 (KV-cache perf regression) - https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-542
- Slack thread: #kv-cache-perf - https://slack.redwood.com/archives/C01234567/p1623456789000

End of notes.

Quick checklist before meeting:
- [x] Review PR #278 diff & comments
- [x] Check latest perf harness run (results from 2026-03-01)
- [ ] Write promotion packet follow-up email
- [ ] Ping SRE (Taylor) about tracing access
